title: Identification of perrhenate-binding peptides by phage display
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,12877-12883
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA08091F, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Samuel Takyi, Mark Aldren M. Feliciano, Dulanjali S. Sooriyage, Brian Gold, Mark C. Walker
Phage display was used to identify peptides that could bind perrhenate and remove it from aqueous solution when immobilized on resin. This is a first step towards engineering bioremediation of pertechnetate.
